source: R12.4 (requirements.md lines 113-116) + the closed basis-registry design table (4 codes: signature-verified/oracle-established/authority-attested/input-computed) authored in this task's brief. Expected admit/reject verdicts are reasoned directly from that text, never computed by naalp_evidentiality.evidentiality (not imported here). Non-cryptographic wire bytes (content ids, the C4 signer id) are cross-checked against the independent tools/cbor_oracle.py and tools/signerid_oracle.py constructors (asserted equal above, before this dict is returned). Cryptographic material (ML-DSA signatures, the audit receipt chain) is produced with the real, independently-graded Part-1 SDK (naalp.cose / naalp.identity / naalp.audit) -- the SAME primitives naalp_evidentiality itself delegates every check to.
